articles.title_en: Shocks, Frictions, and Inequality in US Business Cycles
articles.title_cn: 冲击、摩擦与美国商业周期中的不平等
articles.abstract_en: We show how a heterogeneous agent New Keynesian (HANK) model with incomplete markets and portfolio choice can be estimated in state space using a Bayesian approach. To render estimation feasible, the structure of the economy can be exploited and the dimensionality of the model automatically reduced based on the Bayesian priors. We apply this approach to analyze how much inequality matters for the business cycle and vice versa. Even when the model is estimated on aggregate data alone and with a set of shocks and frictions designed to match aggregate data, it broadly reproduces observed US inequality dynamics.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们展示了如何利用贝叶斯方法在状态空间中估计一个具有不完全市场和投资组合选择的异质代理人新凯恩斯（HANK）模型。为了使估计可行，可以利用经济结构，并基于贝叶斯先验自动降低模型的维度。我们应用这种方法来分析不平等对商业周期的影响程度，反之亦然。即使模型仅基于总量数据估计，并设计了一组冲击和摩擦以匹配总量数据，它也能大致再现观察到的美国不平等动态。

articles.title_en: Household Labor Supply and the Value of Social Security Survivors Benefits
articles.title_cn: 家庭劳动力供给与社会保障遗属抚恤金的价值
articles.abstract_en: We combine quasi-experimental variation in spousal death and age eligibility for survivors benefits using US tax records to study the effects on American households' labor supply and the design of social security's survivors insurance. Benefit eligibility at the exact age of 60 induces sharp reductions in the labor supply of newly widowed households, highlighting the value of survivors benefits and the liquidity they provide following the shock. Among eligible widows, the spousal death event induces no increases in labor supply, suggesting little residual need to self-insure. Using theory, we underscore the program's protective insurance role and its high valuation among survivors.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用美国税收记录中配偶死亡和遗属抚恤金年龄资格的半实验性变化，研究其对美国家庭劳动力供给的影响以及社会保障遗属保险的设计。在恰好年满60岁时获得资格，导致新丧偶家庭的劳动力供给急剧减少，凸显了遗属抚恤金的价值及其在冲击后提供的流动性。在符合条件的寡妇中，配偶死亡事件并未导致劳动力供给增加，表明几乎没有剩余的自我保险需求。通过理论分析，我们强调了该计划的保护性保险作用及其在遗属中的高估值。

articles.title_en: Creating Moves to Opportunity: Experimental Evidence on Barriers to Neighborhood Choice
articles.title_cn: 创造流动机会：邻里选择障碍的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Low-income families often live in low-upward-mobility neighborhoods. We study why by using a randomized trial with housing voucher recipients that provided information, financial support, and customized search assistance to move to high-opportunity neighborhoods. The treatment increased the fraction moving to high-upward-mobility areas from 15 to 53 percent. A second trial reveals this treatment effect is driven primarily by customized search assistance. Qualitative interviews show that the intervention relaxed bandwidth constraints and addressed family-specific needs. Our findings imply many low-income families do not have strong preferences to stay in low-opportunity areas and that barriers in housing search significantly increase residential segregation by income.
articles.abstract_cn: 低收入家庭往往居住在上行流动性低的社区。我们通过一项针对住房券受助者的随机试验来研究其原因，该试验提供了信息、财政支持和定制化搜索援助，以帮助其迁往高机会社区。该干预措施将迁往高上行流动性地区的比例从15提高到53%。第二项试验表明，这一处理效应主要由定制化搜索援助驱动。定性访谈显示，干预措施缓解了带宽限制，并解决了家庭特定需求。我们的研究结果表明，许多低收入家庭并没有强烈偏好留在低机会地区，住房搜索中的障碍显著加剧了按收入划分的居住隔离。

articles.title_en: From Fog to Smog: The Value of Pollution Information
articles.title_cn: 从雾到霾：污染信息的价值
articles.abstract_en: In 2013, China launched a landmark program to monitor air quality and disclose real-time data, significantly increasing the public's access to and awareness of pollution information. The program triggered cascading behavioral changes such as stronger avoidance of outdoor pollution exposure and increased spending on protective products. These behavioral responses mitigated the mortality impact of air pollution. Conservative estimates indicate that the program's health benefits outweigh the costs by an order of magnitude. The findings highlight the benefits of improving public access to pollution information in developing countries which often experience severe air pollution but lack pollution data collection and dissemination.
articles.abstract_cn: 2013年，中国启动了一项具有里程碑意义的空气质量监测和实时数据公开项目，显著提高了公众获取和了解污染信息的程度。该项目引发了连锁行为变化，如更强烈地避免户外污染暴露和增加防护产品的支出。这些行为反应减轻了空气污染对死亡率的影响。保守估计表明，该项目的健康效益比成本高出一个数量级。研究结果强调了在经常遭受严重空气污染但缺乏污染数据收集和传播的发展中国家，改善公众获取污染信息的益处。

articles.title_en: Urban Public Works in Spatial Equilibrium: Experimental Evidence from Ethiopia
articles.title_cn: 空间均衡中的城市公共工程：来自埃塞俄比亚的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper evaluates a large urban public works program randomly rolled out across neighborhoods of Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. We find the program increased public employment and reduced private labor supply among beneficiaries and improved local amenities in treated locations. We then combine a spatial equilibrium model and unique commuting data to estimate the spillover effects of the program on private sector wages across neighborhoods: under full program rollout, wages increased by 18.6 percent. Using our model, we show that welfare gains to the poor are six times larger when we include the indirect effects on private wages and local amenities.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文评估了一项在埃塞俄比亚亚的斯亚贝巴各街区随机推出的大型城市公共工程计划。我们发现该计划增加了公共就业，减少了受益者的私人劳动力供给，并改善了受处理地区的本地设施。然后，我们结合空间均衡模型和独特的通勤数据来估计该计划对跨街区私营部门工资的溢出效应：在全面实施该计划的情况下，工资上涨了18.6%。利用我们的模型，我们表明，当我们将对私人工资和本地设施的间接影响包括在内时，穷人的福利收益要大六倍。

articles.title_en: Resisting Social Pressure in the Household Using Mobile Money: Experimental Evidence on Microenterprise Investment in Uganda
articles.title_cn: 使用移动货币抵制家庭内部社会压力：乌干达微型企业投资的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: I examine whether changing the form of disbursement of a microfinance loan enables female microfinance borrowers to overcome intra-household sharing pressure and grow their businesses. Using a field experiment with 3,000 borrowers in Uganda, I compare the disbursement of a loan as cash to disbursement onto a digital account. After 8 months, women who received their microfinance loan on the digital account had 11 percent higher (US$70) business capital and 15 percent higher (US$18) profits compared to those who received their loan as cash. Impacts were greatest for women who experienced pressure to share money with others in the household at baseline.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了改变小额信贷贷款的发放形式是否能使女性小额信贷借款人克服家庭内部的分享压力并发展她们的企业。通过在乌干达对3,000名借款人进行的实地实验，我将贷款以现金发放与发放到数字账户进行了比较。8个月后，与以现金形式获得小额信贷贷款的女性相比，通过数字账户获得贷款的女性的商业资本高出11%%（US$70），利润高出15%%（US$18）。对于在基线时感受到家庭内部与他人分享金钱压力的女性，影响最大。

articles.title_en: A Framework for Economic Growth with Capital-Embodied Technical Change
articles.title_cn: 资本体现型技术变革的经济增长框架
articles.abstract_en: Technological advance is often embodied in capital inputs, like computers, airplanes, and robots. This paper builds a framework where capital inputs advance through (i) increased automation and (ii) increased productivity. The interplay of these two innovation dimensions can produce balanced growth, satisfying the Uzawa Growth Theorem even though technological progress is capital-embodied. The framework can further address structural transformation, general-purpose technologies, the limited macroeconomic impact of computing, and declining productivity growth and labor shares. Overall, this tractable framework can help resolve puzzling tensions between micro-level observations of innovation and balanced growth while providing new perspectives on numerous macroeconomic phenomena.
articles.abstract_cn: 技术进步往往体现在资本投入中，如计算机、飞机和机器人。本文构建了一个框架，其中资本投入通过（i）自动化程度的提高和（ii）生产率的提高而进步。这两个创新维度的相互作用可以产生平衡增长，满足Uzawa增长定理，即使技术进步是资本体现型的。该框架还可以进一步解决结构转型、通用目的技术、计算对宏观经济影响的有限性以及生产率增长和劳动份额下降等问题。总体而言，这个易于处理的框架有助于解决微观层面的创新观察与平衡增长之间令人困惑的紧张关系，同时为众多宏观经济现象提供新的视角。

articles.abstract_en: Binscatter is a popular method for visualizing bivariate relationships and conducting informal specification testing. We study the properties of this method formally and develop enhanced visualization and econometric binscatter tools. These include estimating conditional means with optimal binning and quantifying uncertainty. We also highlight a methodological problem related to covariate adjustment that can yield incorrect conclusions. We revisit two applications using our methodology and find substantially different results relative to those obtained using prior informal binscatter methods. General purpose software in Python, R, and Stata is provided. Our technical work is of independent interest for the nonparametric partition-based estimation literature.
articles.abstract_cn: 分箱散点图是一种用于可视化双变量关系并进行非正式设定检验的流行方法。我们正式研究了该方法的性质，并开发了增强的可视化和计量经济学分箱散点图工具。这些工具包括通过最优分箱估计条件均值以及量化不确定性。我们还强调了与协变量调整相关的一个方法论问题，该问题可能导致错误的结论。我们使用我们的方法重新审视了两个应用，并发现与使用先前非正式分箱散点图方法所得结果相比，结果存在显著差异。我们提供了Python、R和Stata中的通用软件。我们的技术工作对于非参数分区估计文献具有独立的意义。
